face_shape.oval_male: Most styles suit an oval face. Try a tidy taper, textured crop, or side part.
face_shape.oval_female: Most styles suit an oval face. Try long layers, soft waves, or a clean bob.
face_shape.round_male: Add visual height with a textured quiff, pompadour, or shorter sides.
face_shape.round_female: Create length with layers below the chin, a side part, or loose waves.
face_shape.square_male: Balance a defined jaw with a textured crop, side part, or softly tapered sides.
face_shape.square_female: Soften angular lines with face-framing layers, waves, or a side-swept fringe.
face_shape.heart_male: Balance a wider forehead with a side-swept fringe, textured crop, or medium-length layers.
face_shape.heart_female: Balance the forehead with side-swept bangs, chin-length layers, or a soft bob.
face_shape.oblong_male: Keep some fullness at the sides and avoid excessive height on top.
face_shape.oblong_female: Add width with cheekbone-length layers, waves, or a light fringe.
face_shape.square: Balance strong angles with texture and softly rounded lines around the face.
face_shape.heart: Use soft layers or a side part to balance the forehead and chin.
face_shape.oblong: Add width at the sides and avoid too much height at the crown.
face_shape.oval: An oval face suits many styles; choose the cut that matches your hair texture.

hair_type.straight_male: Add texture with a lightweight matte paste and avoid heavy products at the roots.
hair_type.straight_female: Use a light volumizing mousse at the roots and heat protectant before styling.
hair_type.wavy_male: Enhance natural waves with lightweight mousse and air-dry or diffuse on low heat.
hair_type.wavy_female: Use leave-in conditioner and mousse to define waves without making them crunchy.
hair_type.curly_male: Apply curl cream to damp hair, detangle with fingers, and avoid brushing it dry.
hair_type.curly_female: Use a wide-tooth comb on damp hair, curl cream, and gentle drying to reduce frizz.
hair_type.dreadlocks_male: Keep the scalp clean, dry roots thoroughly, and use light products to avoid buildup.
hair_type.dreadlocks_female: Protect locs at night with a satin covering and keep the scalp gently cleansed.
hair_type.kinky_male: Moisturize regularly with leave-in conditioner and detangle gently in small sections.
hair_type.kinky_female: Use rich conditioning treatments and low-tension styles to help retain moisture.

skin_type.oily_male: Use a gentle foaming cleanser, lightweight moisturizer, and broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher.
skin_type.oily_female: Choose non-comedogenic products, a lightweight moisturizer, and broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher.
skin_type.dry_male: Use a gentle cleanser, fragrance-free cream moisturizer, and lukewarm water after washing.
skin_type.dry_female: Apply a fragrance-free cream moisturizer to damp skin and avoid very hot water.
skin_type.normal_male: Keep a simple routine: gentle cleanser, moisturizer, and broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher.
skin_type.normal_female: Maintain a simple routine with gentle cleansing, moisturizer, and daily broad-spectrum SPF.
skin_type.sensitive_male: Choose fragrance-free products, patch-test new products, and use a gentle shaving cream.
skin_type.sensitive_female: Choose fragrance-free products, patch-test first, and introduce one new product at a time.
skin_type.oily: Use a gentle cleanser, lightweight moisturizer, and non-comedogenic SPF 30 or higher.
skin_type.dry: Use a gentle cleanser and fragrance-free moisturizer, especially while skin is still damp.
skin_type.normal: Keep it simple with gentle cleansing, moisturizer, and daily broad-spectrum SPF.

gender.male: Choose a grooming routine that fits your style: keep facial hair neat if you wear it and use daily SPF.
gender.female: Choose products that suit your skin and style, remove makeup gently, and use daily SPF.
gender.unknown: Choose products based on your skin and hair needs, and use broad-spectrum SPF daily.
